newsitem.title: USA: US Midwest direct hogs sell steady-up $1 -dealers.
newsitem.headline: US Midwest direct hogs sell steady-up $1 -dealers.

text.p: U.S. Midwest direct hogs early Tuesday sold steady to $1.00 per cwt higher amid light hog marketings, cash dealers and packer buyers said.
The light marketings created increased competition for supplies, particularly in the eastern Corn Belt, they said.
Illinois hogs sold $0.50 to $1.00 higher at $56.50 to $57.00 in the country and $57.50 to $58.00 at plants.

Interior Iowa and southern Minnesota hogs sold steady at $56.00 to $57.50 in the country and $57.00 to $58.50 for hogs delivered to the plant. But buyers for plants with reduced hours were not aggressively bidding for hogs, they said.
